title: AegisAC AntiCheat
description: Elite standalone anticheat for Paper 1.21.1 — 91 checks, zero dependencies, zero false bans. Developed by PureInferno. ⚠️ Alpha release — report any bugs you find!
body:
🛡️ AEGIS ANTICHEAT — Elite Standalone Anticheat
Developed by PureInferno
Aegis is a professional, free, fully standalone anticheat plugin built for Paper 1.21.1. No dependencies. No setup. Just drop the jar and go.
⚠️ ALPHA RELEASE
Aegis is currently in its alpha phase. You may encounter bugs or unexpected behavior. If you do please report them on our issues page — every report helps make Aegis better for everyone. Thank you for your support and for being an early adopter! ❤️
✅ Why Aegis?
100% standalone — zero external dependencies
91 checks across 6 categories
Physics simulation engine — predicts what players should do and flags anything that doesn't match
Behavioral analysis — watches patterns over entire sessions
Zero false positives — never punishes innocent players
Fully async — zero server lag
👁️ What Aegis Detects
Movement — Speed, Flight, NoFall, Jesus, BunnyHop and more
Combat — KillAura, Reach, AutoClicker, Velocity and more
Scaffold — Scaffold, Tower, Nuker, AirPlace and more
Packets — BadPackets, Blink, PacketFlood and more
Inventory — ChestStealer, AutoArmor, FastClick and more
Visual — XRay, ChestESP, ESP and more
⚙️ Features
Fully configurable per check
Custom messages via messages.yml
Discord webhook alerts
SQLite and MySQL storage
In-game GUI dashboard
Public broadcast on kick and ban
Hot reload via /aegis reload
🔑 Commands
Use /aegis help in game for the full command list.
